notes: Fix: Hinglish transcription seeming stuck at one percentage (for example 35 %) on slower computers. The extra accuracy checks added in 0.9.9 and 0.9.10 can take several times longer than the transcription itself on a slow PC. They now have a time limit based on how fast your computer is, so the transcript always finishes; anything skipped is listed in a warning. On a fast computer nothing is skipped and the result is the same as before.
Improved: the progress bar keeps moving while those extra checks run, instead of standing still.
